messages.subject: For Mike Cinnamond | International mining, government relations and country execution
messages.body:
Dear B2Gold Investor Relations Team,

Please place this executive introduction before Mr. Mike Cinnamond, President and Chief Executive Officer.

B2Gold's international operating portfolio requires strong country-level execution across governments, communities, sustainability commitments and operating teams. That interface closely matches the work I lead today inside a major multinational mining operation.

I serve as Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department at AGM Inc., part of Zijin Mining Group. My mandate combines government and regulatory relations, ESG, social performance, corporate affairs, strategic partnerships and executive advisory. I manage senior institutional engagement and coordinate complex stakeholder matters across operations, environment, HSE, legal, finance, HR, procurement, security and technical teams. I also support stakeholder governance around approximately 46 to 50 MWp of solar capacity and more than 80 MWh of battery storage and coordinated a carbon-accounting evidence pilot using operating data.

I would welcome a senior conversation about where this combination of government relations, ESG, social performance and country-level mining execution might support B2Gold's international priorities. My attached CV has been tailored specifically to B2Gold.

Kind regards,
Ragunauth Ramsaroop
Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department | AGM Inc.
